_comment: Pinned third-party downloads for the Windows build. Hashes are SHA256 of the exact files. Build-Runtime.ps1 verifies everything against these hashes and refuses to package a mismatch. Setup.ps1 and the CI workflow download each one from a VERSIONED url (never 'latest'), so a pin stays valid until it is deliberately upgraded - pins to 'latest' used to break CI every time upstream shipped a release. To upgrade a tool: change the version in the url here AND in Setup.ps1 and .github/workflows/build.yml, update the hash, and test the app end-to-end, all in one commit. (yt-dlp is no longer a separate .exe: it's the pinned Python package in requirements-app.lock.txt, the same on every OS.)

deno.exe._note: REQUIRED, not optional - yt-dlp shells out to this as its JS runtime to pass YouTube's anti-bot/signature challenge. Without it, downloads fail with HTTP 403. Not referenced by name anywhere in our own scripts, which is exactly why it got dropped once already - don't repeat that mistake.

runtime._comment: The Python the Windows installer bundles (runtime/). Must be the same minor version as the host Python Build-Runtime.ps1 installs packages with (3.12 - also what setup.sh uses on macOS/Linux, so every OS runs the same Python and the same pinned packages).

python-embed._note: 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 release with Windows binaries (later 3.12.x are source-only security releases).
